items.source: Route the invocation to the configured managed resource.

items.source: invocation - the MethodInvocation to re-route
items.translation: invocation - 要重新路由的 MethodInvocation

items.source: By default, the MBeanClientInterceptor will connect to the MBeanServer and cache MBean metadata at startup. This can be undesirable when running against a remote MBeanServer that may not be running when the application starts. Through setting the connectOnStartup property to "false", you can defer this process until the first invocation against the proxy.
items.translation: 默认情况下，MBeanClientInterceptor 会连接到 MBeanServer 并在启动时缓存 MBean 元数据。当针对可能在应用程序启动时未运行的远程 MBeanServer 运行时，这可能是不希望的。通过将 connectOnStartup 属性设置为 "false"，您可以将此过程推迟到首次调用代理时。

items.source: When using strict casing, a JavaBean property with a getter such as getFoo() translates to an attribute called Foo. With strict casing disabled, getFoo() would translate to just foo.
items.translation: 使用严格大小写时，具有 `getFoo()` 这样的 getter 的 JavaBean 属性会转换为名为 `Foo` 的属性。禁用严格大小写后，`getFoo()` 将仅转换为 `foo`。

items.source: This functionality is usually used through MBeanProxyFactoryBean. See the javadoc of that class for more information.
items.translation: 此功能通常通过 `MBeanProxyFactoryBean` 使用。有关更多信息，请参阅该类的 Javadoc。

items.source: Default is none. If specified, this will result in an attempt being made to locate the attendant MBeanServer, unless the "serviceUrl" property has been set.
items.translation: 默认值为无。如果指定了该值，将尝试查找相关的 MBeanServer，除非已设置 `"serviceUrl"` 属性。

items.source: Useful for specifying entries directly, for example via environment[myKey]. This is particularly useful for adding or overriding entries in child bean definitions.
items.translation: 适用于直接指定条目，例如通过 `environment[myKey]`。这对于在子 Bean 定义中添加或覆盖条目特别有用。

items.source: Specifying the empty String indicates the platform MBeanServer.
items.translation: 指定空字符串表示平台 MBeanServer。

items.source:
Can be turned on to allow for hot restart of the JMX server,
automatically reconnecting and retrying in case of an IOException.
items.translation: 可启用以允许 JMX 服务器进行热重启，在发生 IOException 时自动重新连接并重试。

items.source:
If not configured to refresh on connect failure, this method
simply rethrows the original exception.
items.translation: 如果未配置为在连接失败时刷新，此方法将简单地重新抛出原始异常。

items.source: Set whether the proxy should connect to the MBeanServer at creation time (true) or the first time it is invoked (false). Default is true.
items.translation: 设置代理是在创建时（true）还是首次调用时（false）连接到 MBeanServer。默认值为 true。

items.source: Set the ObjectName of the MBean which calls are routed to, as ObjectName instance or as String.
items.translation: 将调用路由到的 MBean 的 `ObjectName` 设置为 `ObjectName` 实例或 `String`。

items.source: Route the invocation to the configured managed resource. Correctly routes JavaBean property access to MBeanServerConnection.get/setAttribute and method invocation to MBeanServerConnection.invoke.
items.translation: 将调用路由到配置的托管资源。正确地将 JavaBean 属性访问路由到 `MBeanServerConnection.get/setAttribute`，并将方法调用路由到 `MBeanServerConnection.invoke`。

items.source: Prepares the MBeanServerConnection if the "connectOnStartup" is turned on (which it is by default).
items.translation: 如果“启动时连接”已启用（默认情况下是启用的），则准备 `<code>MBeanServerConnection`。

items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在销毁 Bean 时调用。

items.source: Return the management interface of the target MBean, or null if none specified.

items.source: Ensures that an MBeanServerConnection is configured and attempts to detect a local connection if one is not supplied.
items.translation: 确保已配置 `MBeanServerConnection`，并且如果未提供本地连接，则尝试检测本地连接。

items.source: Set the MBeanServerConnection used to connect to the MBean which all invocations are routed to.
items.translation: 设置用于连接到所有调用都路由到的 MBean 的 `MBeanServerConnection`。

items.source:
Convert the given result object (from attribute access or operation invocation)
to the specified target class for returning from the proxy method.
items.translation: 将给定的结果对象（来自属性访问或操作调用）转换为指定的目标类，以便从代理方法返回。

items.source: Specify the environment for the JMX connector.
items.translation: 指定 JMX 连接器的环境。

items.source:
Set the management interface of the target MBean, exposing bean property
setters and getters for MBean attributes and conventional Java methods
for MBean operations.
items.translation: 设置目标 MBean 的管理接口，暴露用于 MBean 属性的 Bean 属性 setter 和 getter，以及用于 MBean 操作的常规 Java 方法。
